Pass 3 — the daylight engine, a guaranteed fox, and a readable dusk
summary: Three complaints drove this pass: no wow, too dark, no fox. (1) Daylight engine: pure lib/daylight.ts (5 keyframes golden hour -> night -> sunrise) sampled per frame by DaylightDriver into sky uniforms, lights, fog and effect gains; dusk dial in the rest menu plus [ ] keys; sunrise end doubles as the max-visibility anchor. Found and fixed a scene-wide bug: three r155+ physical light units had the whole forest rendering ~3x darker than authored (intensities now x pi once, in the driver). (2) Fox first contact: spawn moved inside alert radius straight down the spawn vista (freeze-and-stare opening, asserted headlessly), director tightened (90 m recast, 28-40 m lead), one-shot whisper hint on first close pass. (3) Fox mind HUD: live state/distance/flavor panel polled from a module-level snapshot store (M key or Fox-mind touch button). Verified: typecheck, build, forest.check (new daylight + first-contact checks), browser smoke, visual probe screenshots at golden/night/sunrise.

Pass 4 — the mobile white line and the dusk-shrine score
summary: Two complaints drove this pass: an unwanted white line in the mobile layout, and a requested calmer, Dark Souls-flavoured soundtrack. (1) White line: a mobile probe (iPhone-class Chrome, 360/390/414 px, rest+play states, DOM light-element sweep + geometry reads) found exactly one pure-white painted element — the dusk dial's <input type=range>, whose UA widget paints a white background box and pale track reading as a light line in the dark dial. Fixed by hand-theming the slider (appearance:none, 4px dark track, amber fill via --ef-dial-fill set by DuskDial on mount/poll/drag, amber knob, -moz variants); sweep is now clean at all three widths. (2) Score: replaced the wind/crickets/owl bedscape with web/lib/music.ts (delegated design, integrated by hand) — a procedural D-aeolian 'dusk shrine' loop: breathing D2+A2 drone, slow open-fifth/add9 pad swells, sparse bell-like D-minor-pentatonic+dorian melody, rare chime, runtime-built convolution reverb, one 38.4s cycle scheduled by a single lookahead timer with tails ringing across the boundary (seamless loop); MUSIC_LEVEL 0.16 leaves footstep/master headroom. ambience.ts now hosts only the shared context, mute/dim ramps and footstep synth. Also: browser-smoke navigation wait moved off networkidle0 (Vite HMR socket never settles it); new music-probe harness. Verified: typecheck, build, forest.check(27), browser-smoke(12), mobile sweep clean, music probe (28 voices, running, envelopes complete, no errors).

title: Pass 5 — the score, audible
summary: User report: the new score is barely hearable. Root causes: MUSIC_LEVEL 0.16 sat far too low for sparse sine/triangle content, and the drone's D2/A2 fundamentals (73-110 Hz) fall below what phone speakers reproduce. Raised MUSIC_LEVEL to 0.42 (+8.4 dB overall), NOTE_LEVEL to 0.22 and PAD_LEVEL to 0.16 (signature layers up relative), and added a quiet D3 octave partial (DRONE_OCTAVE_LEVEL 0.3, breathing with the drone LFO) so the floor registers on small drivers. Worst-case coinciding peak now ~0.32 full scale into destination (was ~0.12), footsteps still keep headroom. Verified: typecheck clean, music probe (29 voices, context running, envelopes complete, no errors). Ear-tuning knobs remain the named constants atop web/lib/music.ts.

title: feat(evening-forest): fix the mobile white line, swap the ambience for a dusk-shrine score
Pass 6 — fuller score, HUD clear of the button bar
summary: Bug-evening-forest report (iOS Safari): score read sparse/thin, and the fox-mind readout collided with the touch button bar. Score: bus now runs through a glue compressor (thr -18/knee 20/ratio 2/makeup 1.5) with MUSIC_LEVEL 0.5; drone gained a D4 partial (0.12) and D3 octave raised to 0.32 for phone speakers; pad blooms twice per cycle (second at 75%); melody spacing tightened to 1.6-4.6s with 55% neighbour-note echoes at 40% level; new looped filtered-noise night-air bed (420Hz bandpass, AIR_LEVEL 0.045, slow filter+gain LFOs) feeding dry+reverb; chime 0.08. Layout: at <=720px the .ef-fox-mind readout drops below the touch button bar (top = env(safe-area-inset-top) + 3.8rem, ~15px clearance at 390px). Micro-polish: aria-pressed styling on touch buttons. All stochasticity stays on the seeded rng; new continuous nodes registered for teardown.

title: feat(evening-forest): fuller dusk-shrine score, HUD clear of the button bar
Pass 7 — the fox mind owns the corner, Rest moves under the thumb
summary: User report: the fox-mind readout hanging below the top-left corner (Pass 6's collision workaround) reads wrong, and the mobile white band persists in Safari and Yandex. (1) Layout: the readout is pinned back to the top-left corner at every width; the top row now holds only the Fox-mind toggle (panel ≈209px + toggle ≈87px fits 360px with room, verified non-overlapping by a new smoke assertion). Sound + Rest moved to a bottom-right cluster (safe-area aware) — Rest under the resting thumb; the drag-to-look hint floats above the cluster until first drag. (2) White band: the band in the bug screenshot is the shell's near-white body (#e4e5e1) showing wherever the frame chain under-fills the viewport — mobile WebKit (Safari, and Yandex via WKWebView) can leave the frame a toolbar-height short when the dynamic viewport shifts. Made the gap impossible instead of chasing the browser: page, :has-scoped frame, and body all paint dusk-dark (#140b20) while the forest is mounted, so any viewport shortfall reads as fog; added 100vh fallback lines under every 100dvh use. Verified: typecheck, build, forest.check, browser smoke 13/13 (new: panel clears toggle; Rest works from bottom-right), mobile probe 360/390/414 clean — screenshots show corner panel, bottom cluster, full-bleed canvas.
